about.metaTitle: About Menuyukti — Build your restaurant stack
about.metaDescription: One platform for restaurant owners: free POS and inventory, then modular digital menu, landing page, loyalty, and hands-on services—without a fragmented stack of providers.
about.title: Build your restaurant stack
about.intro: Running a restaurant shouldn’t mean managing a different provider for every part of the business.
about.introFollow: Menuyukti gives restaurant owners one platform for the services they need to run, grow, and market their restaurant—from POS and inventory to digital menus, loyalty, online presence, marketing, and more.
about.introClose: Start with the core. Add what you need. Turn services on or off as your restaurant changes.
about.fragmentedBody: A typical restaurant might have one company for POS, spreadsheets for inventory, another app for loyalty, a separate website provider, and someone else handling social media.
about.fragmentedBodyFollow: That means more subscriptions, more logins, more invoices—and important parts of the restaurant operating with different information.
about.fragmentedBodyApproach: Instead of adding another disconnected tool, we are building a platform where restaurant services work from the same foundation.
about.foundationTitle: It starts with the restaurant itself
about.foundationBody: The menu, sales, products, locations, staff, and stock are at the center of restaurant operations.
about.foundationBodyWhy: That is why Menuyukti starts with POS and inventory.
about.foundationBodyOps: A sale can update stock. Locations can transfer inventory without separate spreadsheets. Owners and staff can have their own access. And services added later can work with the same restaurant data instead of creating another isolated system.
about.foundationBodyMenu: Update a menu item once, and that information can be used across the POS, digital menu, restaurant website, and other services.
about.foundationBodyClose: The result is one foundation that becomes more useful as you build on it.
about.modularTitle: Build the stack your restaurant needs
about.modularBodyFollow: A small café does not need the same technology as a busy restaurant group with multiple locations. And what a restaurant needs today may be different six months from now.
about.modularBodyWhy: That is why Menuyukti is modular.
about.modularBodyHow: Start with the foundation. Add services when they make sense. Pause what you no longer need. Add something new when your restaurant grows.
about.modularBodyClose: Think of it like cloud services for a restaurant: one foundation with services you can turn on as you need them.

coreItems.name: POS + Inventory
paragraphs: The free core of Menuyukti for everyday restaurant operations.
Run the register, manage stock, transfer inventory between locations, and give owners and staff access to the same operational workspace.
Because POS and inventory share the same foundation, stock can stay connected to what is actually being sold instead of relying on disconnected spreadsheets and manual catch-up.

addonItems.name: Digital Menu
paragraphs: Guests scan a QR code and open your menu directly in their browser.
No App Store download. No account required just to see the menu.

addonItems.name: Restaurant Landing Page
paragraphs: Turn the menu you already manage in Menuyukti into an SEO-optimized restaurant landing page designed to help people find your restaurant on Google.

Menu items, categories, descriptions, prices, opening information, and other restaurant details can be used to create a search-friendly online presence—so guests can discover you when they search—without maintaining the same information in another system.
Update your menu in Menuyukti, and your online presence can stay connected to the same source.
addonItems.emphasis: Manage the menu once. Use it everywhere.

addonItems.name: Stamp Card
paragraphs: Give returning guests a simple digital stamp card without introducing another standalone loyalty platform.

addonItems.name: Cashback
paragraphs: Reward returning guests with cashback connected to the same customer experience.

about.addonsMore: More services can be added over time without changing the foundation underneath them.
about.guestBody: Restaurant technology should remove friction—not move it from the owner to the customer.
about.guestBodyMenu: Guests can scan a QR code and open a Menuyukti digital menu immediately in their browser. There is nothing to install and no account required to browse.
about.guestBodySignIn: If they later want rewards, ordering, or a saved profile, they can sign in with Google or email and continue where they left off.
about.guestBodyInstall: Regular guests can also add Menuyukti to their home screen for an app-like experience without downloading another restaurant app.
about.servicesIntroBody: Not everything a restaurant needs can be solved with another piece of software.

serviceItems.name: Creative Services
paragraphs: Photography and creative work for menus, campaigns, and your restaurant brand.

serviceItems.name: Social Media Services
paragraphs: Content and posting support without needing to build an in-house marketing team.

serviceItems.name: Custom Development
paragraphs: Custom technology for restaurants that need something beyond the standard Menuyukti services.

about.servicesClose: Software and hands-on services can live under the same relationship instead of requiring another collection of providers.
about.costTitle: Built to keep restaurant technology affordable
about.costBody: Restaurant owners should not have to assemble an expensive collection of software subscriptions just to run a modern restaurant.
about.costBodyFollow: Menuyukti is built with a lean technology stack, low overhead, and automation and AI where they genuinely help reduce the cost of providing a service.
about.costBodyNot: The goal is not to sell restaurants as much software as possible.
about.costBodyGoal: The goal is to give each restaurant the stack it actually needs—at a cost that makes sense.
about.costBodyCore: POS + Inventory is the free core. Additional services can be added as needed on a monthly basis.
about.growTitle: Start small. Build as you grow.
growItems: Turn your existing menu into an SEO-optimized restaurant landing page.
Turn on loyalty when it makes sense.
Bring in creative or social media support when you need help growing.
Add custom technology when your operation demands it.
about.growBody: One restaurant might need three Menuyukti services. Another might need ten.
about.growEmphasis: Menuyukti adapts to the restaurant—not the other way around.
about.tagline: Small services. One platform. Your restaurant stack.
